As training and industry outreach coordinator at NBIS, I help shape how Swedish life scientists and industry partners learn bioinformatics, and I still teach myself.

## Industry outreach
I work to make NBIS expertise and training accessible to companies and industry partners, and to build collaborations that connect academia, national infrastructure and industry.

- Opening NBIS training to industry partners
- Bringing NBIS data-analysis expertise to company questions
- Building lasting bridges between academia, infrastructure and industry

[Discuss a collaboration](contact.qmd){.btn-pill}
:::

## Training coordination

- Planning and coordinating NBIS training: courses, workshops and summer schools
- Keeping the training portfolio aligned with what researchers need in practice
- Helping researchers become confident, independent data analysts

## RaukR {#raukr}

[![](assets/badges/raukr-hex.svg){width=110px fig-alt="RaukR hex logo" style="float:right;margin:0 0 0.5rem 1rem"}](https://raukr.nbis.se)

Since 2018, together with [Sebastian DiLorenzo](https://github.com/Sebastian-D), [Roy Francis](https://royfrancis.com) and other NBIS colleagues, I organise [**RaukR**](https://raukr.nbis.se), the *Advanced R Programming for Bioinformatics* summer school held on the island of Gotland in Visby, Sweden. The course covers writing robust, efficient and reproducible R for life-science data. Course materials and information about upcoming editions are at [raukr.nbis.se](https://raukr.nbis.se).

Over the years, RaukR has hosted guest instructors from the R community, including [Martin Morgan](https://mtmorgan.github.io/), [Paula Moraga](https://www.paulamoraga.com), [Max Kuhn](https://github.com/topepo), [Yihui Xie](https://yihui.org), [Richard Iannone](https://github.com/rich-iannone), [Christophe Dervieux](https://cderv.rbind.io), [Jenny Bryan](https://jennybryan.org) and [Henrik Bengtsson](https://www.jottr.org).

## Courses and workshops

- **RaukR**, *Advanced R Programming for Bioinformatics*, Visby. Co-organiser, annually since 2018 ([raukr.nbis.se](https://raukr.nbis.se)).
<!-- - **R for non-programmers** and **Advanced R for data scientists**. Course leader. -->
- **R Programming for Life Scientists**, SciLifeLab course, 2015–2020. Course responsible; teacher in five editions, 2015–2017 ([materials from the 2017 Uppsala edition](https://nbisweden.github.io/Rcourse/HT17Uppsala/)).
- **Statistical Methods in Genetic Mapping: An R-based Course**, 4 ECTS graduate course, Nov–Dec 2013. Course responsible and teacher.
- **LUPA Workshop: GWAS Analyses in Stratified Populations**, Uppsala, May 2011. Course responsible.
<!-- - **Next-Generation Sequencing: Bioinformatics and Data Analysis**, PhD-level course. Course responsible. -->
- **Boolean Reasoning**, lectures and labs on random forests. Teacher.
- **Knowledge-based Systems in Bioinformatics**, 2008. Teaching assistant.

## Talks and popular science

**From mythology to artificial intelligence: a short journey through statistical models** (in Swedish: *Från mytologi till artificiell intelligens. En kort resa genom statistiska modeller*)
:   Public lecture in the [13x13 series](https://www.uu.se/institution/fysik-och-astronomi/samverkan/13x13/13x13-2025), Uppsala University, 5 November 2025, Humanistiska Teatern. The talk follows how people have tried to understand the world, from myth to modern statistical models and AI: how such models are built, how reliable they are, and what to look out for when a new AI model appears. 13x13 is a series of thirteen free lectures, organised by the Department of Physics and Astronomy, in which Uppsala researchers present their work to a general audience.
